 #### STARTUP-001 — Required configuration diagnostics
 
-**Requirement.** A shared configuration table validates required and conditional bindings for the Worker, scheduled entry point, local app, preview, setup, deployment and private runner before each begins work. Missing or malformed required values stop the entry point and name the variable without printing its value; a Worker configuration failure returns 503, including at `/health`. Hosted mode requires the selected Base mail provider and its sender configuration. Supersedes `BASE-OPS-001`'s one-second health budget with the owner-approved three-second readiness response budget of 16 October 2026 (RL-2). See [Configuration diagnostics](docs/contract/safety-rules.md#configuration-diagnostics).
+**Requirement.** A shared configuration table validates required and conditional bindings for the Worker, scheduled entry point, local app, preview, setup, deployment and private runner before each begins work. Missing or malformed required values stop the entry point and name the variable without printing its value; a Worker configuration failure returns 503, including at `/health`. Hosted mode requires the selected Base mail provider and its sender configuration. With `MAIL_PROVIDER` set to `rer`, a missing `MAIL_API_KEY` or a value containing whitespace refuses health and native runner claims before admission or durable work; a valid replacement and restart restore health and authenticated idle claims against the same persistence without mail or target work. Supersedes `BASE-OPS-001`'s one-second health budget with the owner-approved three-second readiness response budget of 16 October 2026 (RL-2). See [Configuration diagnostics](docs/contract/safety-rules.md#configuration-diagnostics).
 
 **Acceptance.**
 1. Start each runtime entry point with required and conditional bindings missing/malformed; diagnostics name bindings without values and health returns 503.
 2. Restore settings and recover; exercise D1/ASSETS faults inside the owner-approved three-second readiness response budget.
 
+**Bounded evidence (qualification pending).** `tests/public-paths.mjs` invokes `tests/startup-rer-relay-url-support.mjs` proveRerRelayUrlStartup once against the actual emitted Worker and independently migrated persistent D1. With MAIL_PROVIDER set to rer and a valid synthetic MAIL_API_KEY, independently missing and malformed non-HTTPS MAIL_RELAY_URL settings refuse health and an otherwise-valid native runner claim with 503 naming only the binding. The request origin is independent of the relay setting; captured diagnostics and responses withhold planted values, the observed outbound edge receives no requests, and every durable table remains exact, including populated owner admission, public counters and retained claim custody. A corrected synthetic HTTPS relay and restart on the same persistence restore health 200 and an authenticated idle claim without mail or target work. This qualifies only those two conditional-binding refusals and their correction; the current partial judgment, other configuration, readiness faults and timing, console, hosted and provider qualification remain unchanged.
+
 #### PUBLIC-002 — Declared sessionless paths and rate limits
 
 **Requirement.** Every sessionless route and emitted static path is declared in `seed.json` with its authentication rule and rate-limit class. D1 applies owner-tunable per-client limits in fixed 60-second windows and returns 429 with `Retry-After` after the class limit. A declaration does not bypass route-specific session, runner, heartbeat or development-key checks. Limit values are marked estimated and not load-tested. See [Public paths and rate limits](docs/contract/safety-rules.md#public-paths-and-rate-limits) and [Integrity and authority](docs/contract/safety-rules.md#integrity-and-authority).
